title: SafeGuard Ghana Mobile Money Fraud Case Dataset

source_library.title: Mobile Money Fraud Hackathon Case Study Library
source_library.important_note: The library explicitly states that its 36 records are not 36 verified victims. It includes incidents, attempted scams, official warnings and documented campaign patterns.

records.title: A fabricated credit becomes a real refund
records.summary: A message claims a wallet credit arrived; a caller asks the customer to return it as a refund although the original credit is not established.
records.reported_outcome: No case-specific loss stated; documented pattern.

evidence.source_summary: Bank of Ghana fraud report; aggregate pattern, not one named victim.
evidence.source_access_note: Use the original Case Study Library PDF for the source list and linked references. No URL is fabricated here.

limitations: A case record is not proof that every person, phone number, wallet or provider mentioned is malicious.
Do not infer missing transaction steps, credential use or attacker identity.
